topic: MemCompiler public implementation chronology versus evaluated paper versions

facts: v2, the current paper version observed in this run, was submitted 2026-05-14 02:47:01 UTC.
The observed main branch begins with root commit d09a5462f5af6f19478c3f8dedb0b9c4d36dac1a dated 2026-05-23 16:11:25 UTC, described as the initial release for ALFWorld and ScienceWorld.

The current evaluation script tasks/eval_with_trained_model.py first appears in commit ec5a5792873dc84785036a69a73d1cf2c669c0f9 dated 2026-05-29 01:09:42 UTC; the path-specific history has only this commit.

scope_limited_findings.claim: Every observed public GitHub main commit postdates arXiv v2 by at least nine days, and the current public evaluation script was added fifteen days after v2. Therefore the public GitHub revision cannot be identified as the exact code revision that produced the already-reported v1/v2 results solely from chronology; it is a later public release surface unless an explicit provenance bridge binds it to the evaluated internal bytes.
scope_limited_findings.scope: Chronology/provenance conclusion only. It does not imply the later public code is behaviorally different from the authors' evaluated internal code.

scope_limited_findings.claim: A current-code observation such as UPDATE_MEMORY=true or a particular local output/memory path must not be retroactively attributed to the arXiv-v2 experiment without an evaluated-run manifest or equivalent bridge, because the public file containing those defaults did not exist in public history until 2026-05-29.
scope_limited_findings.scope: Attribution boundary; not a statement about unpublished author settings.

protocol_relation.existing_gate: evaluated implementation revision / mechanism fingerprint provenance gate
protocol_relation.rule: Public implementation bytes that postdate a reported evaluation remain useful mechanism evidence but are not evaluated-run identity evidence without an explicit bridge artifact.

next_action: Prioritize bridge artifacts: exact ScienceWorld model upload history, model card/config, memory DB/candidate-pool snapshot, run manifest, or author-published digest that binds Table-3 conditions to code/data/memory bytes.
